summary: Market tone is moderately bullish on select altcoins while Bitcoin looks mixed-to-soft, with traders favoring relative-strength names and correlation plays. The strongest fresh conviction in the gathered posts is on NEAR and ZEC-linked upside, while BTC and several majors are described more as range-bound or vulnerable to rejection.
